'''Aine''' is the fourth month in the [[Farede calendar]]. In most years, it is equivalent to the real world period from [[March]] [[March 16|16]] to [[April]] [[April 12|12]]. The spring equinox/first day of spring is celebrated during this month.

==Parallels==
[[Wikipedia:Aine|Aine]] is an Irish Goddess. This is one of several months in the [[Farede calendar]] to be named from Irish mythology, the two others being [[Danu]] and [[Amadaine]]. Aine was celebrated at midsummer and sometimes associated with the Sun – the spring equinox/first day of spring is celebrated in this month.
